purpose: Engineering analogy that operationalizes all 37 bodhipakkhiya-dhamma factors for repository-based agent loops, with a Four Noble Truths wisdom-routing overlay, episodic sati, and transient five-aggregate task state.
doctrinal_boundary: Early-discourse identifiers are the normative Buddhist source tier for this skill. Canonical ontology and engineering mappings retain provenance; later Buddhist/Mahayana vocabulary may appear only as an explicitly marked presentation adapter and never silently rewrite the early-discourse source layer.
recursive_invariants: The minimum operational kernel closes only when action changes state and the changed state is reobserved through 四念処.
正精進 integrates the four right efforts.
正念 integrates the four establishments of mindfulness.
正定 integrates concentration capability within a harness; the four-jhāna mapping is an engineering analogy, not literal identity.
正見 uses the four-truth task model; its path component recursively points to the integrated path architecture.
All five faculties are coequal explicit-reference capabilities; 信 is not a preliminary layer outside 五根.
五力 require AI-alone execution under an unstated or disturbed case and resist 不信, 懈怠, 放逸, 掉挙, and 無明 respectively.
Canonical 四不壊浄 content belongs inside 信根 and 信力 while remaining Human Only Write / Agent Read Only through external technical enforcement.
七覚支 is the adaptive meta-controller: mindfulness remains active; investigation/energy/joy activate sluggish loops; tranquility/concentration/equanimity calm restless loops.
The Four Noble Truths wisdom graph is a navigation/judgment overlay on the existing 37 factors; it does not add a 38th factor.

Durable intervention may not be marked complete while samudaya/cause and nirodha/cessation criteria remain undefined; emergency containment must remain explicitly containment-only until retrospective completion.
Meaningful observations, counterevidence, failed interventions, and superseded judgments are retained with provenance; judgment speed comes from indexing/routing rather than deletion.
At consequential task start and material context boundaries, the agent reconstructs a transient five-aggregate task state; this state is not a permanent self or authority source.

Sati is modeled as episodic retention/recollection, sanna as recognition/structuring, and panna as adjudication; observed memory, reconstructed recall, counterfactual, and prospective simulation remain explicitly distinct.

User orientation and Buddha/Dhamma canonical orientation remain explicit and non-collapsible: the user supplies the authorized living task while early-discourse sources constrain the Buddhist-model side.
